agent_explanation: Body falls diagonally past thin wall's top edge. At step 33 it grazes the top-left corner (9.1,5.0) with distance -0.032 (within tolerance). Next step 34 it penetrates to -0.156, exceeding 0.15 limit. This is a corner collision: closest point is wall corner, not face. Collision detection appears to use axis-aligned distance or miss corner normals, so impulse/positional correction fails to prevent corner tunneling when vertical speed dominates (~7.4 m/s) and radius is large (0.694). Reducing radius to 0.2 removes overlap, confirming penetration depth is radius minus corner distance.
